_README: Machine-readable map of upstream files whose fixes CANNOT be trusted to reach Grain by merge alone, because the real Grain code lives elsewhere. Used by port_audit.py. When an upstream commit touches a `source` key, a human must confirm the change reached every `grain` path (or record why it does not apply). `kind`: 'inert' = the upstream file is byte-identical but UNCOMPILED, its replacement is a separate Grain file; 'relocated' = specific logic was moved out of an otherwise-merged file; 'parallel' = the upstream file is merged in handy/, but a Grain-only twin shares the same bug class and upstream's fix can never reach it. Keep this in step with Upstream/UPSTREAM-DIVERGENCE.md.

src-tauri/src/llm_client.rs.why: Inert (no `mod llm_client;`). Grain's multi-provider LLM client is grain_llm_client.rs; shared reqwest diagnostics live in net_diag.rs; the SAME HTTP bug-class also lives in the parallel cloud STT client stt_client.rs. (#1823, #2211 both landed here and needed hand-porting.)

src-tauri/src/settings.rs.why: Inert (no `mod settings;`). Grain's settings are grain-core AppContext; a NEW upstream setting must be added there and to its Default, or `get_settings().<field>` in merged handy code fails to compile. (#1254 selected_channel needed this.)

src-tauri/src/overlay.rs.why: Handy overlay.rs is compiled directly again: native window, platform geometry, nonactivation, readiness events, audio throttling and hide generations are shared. Grain capture modes/context/icon/clipboard/follow-up adapters and owned visual/waveform presentation are listed here; relevant behavior changes require checking these destinations while the frontend freeze remains in force. See Upstream/OVERLAY-MAINTENANCE.md for the event, settings, lifecycle and acceptance contract.

src-tauri/src/actions.rs.why: Merged in handy/ for its shape, BUT post_process_transcription is relocated to grain_post_process.rs and Grain's action variants live in grain_actions.rs. A fix to post-processing or the finish/guard flow may need porting there (e.g. #1846 trim_freed_memory in FinishGuard::drop did not auto-merge into the diverged actions.rs).

src-tauri/src/audio_toolkit/text.rs.why: finalize_transcript relocated to grain_text.rs; final-text / word-boundary fixes may belong there rather than the merged handy text.rs.

src-tauri/src/managers/transcription.rs.why: Merged in handy/, but Parakeet TDT Flow has Grain-only capture scheduling, native adaptation, and window/token logic that upstream's batch/streaming fixes cannot reach. Check whether the fixed bug-class exists there too.

src-tauri/src/audio_toolkit/audio/record.why: Shared bounded recorder differs from upstream callback/ring-buffer implementation. First-sample acknowledgements, no-sample cancellation, resampler tail and journal callbacks must still satisfy Grain capture callers; a successful merge alone cannot prove those adapters are correct.

src-tauri/src/managers/audio.rs.why: Shared RecordingReadiness/capture-generation API is consumed by Grain startup, feedback, failure and cancellation adapters across every capture family. Review these callers when upstream changes stream startup, disconnect recovery, readiness, stop or mute.
